points.title: 童年与少年时代
points.description: 黑泽明出生于东京一个武士家庭，父亲是一名前陆军军官。他的童年受到武士道精神和西方文化的双重影响。1928年，他进入日本美术学校学习绘画，但未能毕业。这段时期，他对绘画和文学产生了浓厚兴趣，尤其是托尔斯泰和陀思妥耶夫斯基的作品，这些文学影响后来体现在他的电影创作中。他的哥哥也鼓励他接触电影，这为他日后成为导演奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Tokyo to a former samurai family, Kurosawa's childhood was shaped by both bushido spirit and Western influences. In 1928, he entered the Japanese Painting School but did not graduate. During this period, he developed a strong interest in painting and literature, particularly the works of Tolstoy and Dostoevsky, which later influenced his filmmaking. His brother encouraged his exposure to cinema, laying the foundation for his future career as a director.

points.title: 助理导演时期
points.description: 1936年，黑泽明加入PCL电影公司（东宝公司前身）担任助理导演，师从导演山本嘉次郎。在此期间，他参与了多部电影的制作，积累了丰富的电影制作经验。1941年，他执导了首部短片《达摩寺的德国人》，展现了他对视觉叙事的独特理解。这一时期正值日本军国主义扩张时期，黑泽明虽然被迫制作一些宣传电影，但他仍努力在作品中注入人道主义思考，为日后的创作风格奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1936, Kurosawa joined PCL Film Studio (predecessor of Toho) as an assistant director, learning from director Kajiro Yamamoto. During this time, he worked on numerous films, gaining extensive production experience. In 1941, he directed his first short film 'The Men Who Tread on the Tiger's Tail,' showcasing his unique understanding of visual storytelling. This period coincided with Japanese militarism expansion, and while Kurosawa was forced to make some propaganda films, he still infused humanistic thinking into his work, laying the foundation for his future style.

points.title: 导演生涯起步
points.description: 1943年，黑泽明执导了个人首部剧情长片《姿三四郎》，这部关于柔道的电影获得了商业成功，但也因其军国主义色彩受到批评。战后，他拍摄了《美好的星期天》(1947)和《酩酊天使》(1948)，后者标志着他与三船敏郎的首次合作，这一合作将持续二十多年。1949年的《静夜之决斗》确立了他在日本电影界的地位。这一时期，黑泽明开始形成自己独特的视觉风格，并开始关注战后日本社会的道德困境和人性挣扎。
points.descriptionEn: In 1943, Kurosawa directed his first feature film 'Sanshiro Sugata,' a judga-themed film that achieved commercial success but was criticized for its militaristic themes. Post-war, he made 'The Wonderful Sunday' (1947) and 'Drunken Angel' (1948), the latter marking his first collaboration with Toshiro Mifune, a partnership that would last over two decades. 'The Quiet Duel' (1949) established his position in Japanese cinema. During this period, Kurosawa began developing his distinctive visual style and started addressing moral dilemmas and human struggles in post-war Japanese society.

points.title: 国际声誉确立
points.description: 1950年是黑泽明职业生涯的转折点，他执导的《罗生门》在威尼斯电影节获得金狮奖，并在国际上获得广泛赞誉，成为第一部获得西方主流奖项认可的日本电影。随后，他创作了一系列杰作，包括《七武士》(1954)、《活下来》(1955)、《蜘蛛巢城》(1957)和《战国英豪》(1958)。这一时期，黑泽明与三船敏郎、作曲家佐藤胜等建立了长期合作关系，形成了独特的'黑泽明美学'。他的作品融合了日本传统与西方叙事技巧，探讨了普遍的人性主题，获得了国际认可。
points.descriptionEn: 1950 marked a turning point in Kurosawa's career when his film 'Rashomon' won the Golden Lion at the Venice Film Festival and gained international acclaim, becoming the first Japanese film to receive a major Western award. He then created a series of masterpieces including 'Seven Samurai' (1954), 'I Live in Fear' (1955), 'Throne of Blood' (1957), and 'The Hidden Fortress' (1958). During this period, Kurosawa established long-term collaborations with Toshiro Mifune and composer Masaru Sato, forming a distinctive 'Kurosawa aesthetic.' His works blended Japanese tradition with Western narrative techniques, exploring universal human themes and gaining international recognition.

points.title: 创作转型期
points.description: 1960年代中期，黑泽明的创作风格开始转变，他尝试了更现代化的叙事和更复杂的视觉语言。1965年的《红胡子》标志着他与三船敏郎合作的结束。1970年代，他面临创作危机，几部电影遭遇票房失败，包括《电车狂》(1971)。1975年，他执导了《德尔苏·乌扎拉》，这部在苏联拍摄的电影获得了奥斯卡最佳外语片奖，成为首位获得此殊荣的日本导演。这一时期，黑泽明开始探索更个人化的表达方式，同时面临商业压力和创作瓶颈的挑战。
points.descriptionEn: In the mid-1960s, Kurosawa's style began to evolve as he experimented with more modern narratives and complex visual language. 'Red Beard' (1965) marked the end of his collaboration with Toshiro Mifune. In the 1970s, he faced a creative crisis, with several films failing at the box office, including 'Dodes'ka-den' (1971). In 1975, he directed 'Dersu Uzala,' filmed in the Soviet Union, which won the Academy Award for Best Foreign Language Film, making him the first Japanese director to receive this honor. During this period, Kurosawa began exploring more personal forms of expression while facing challenges from commercial pressures and creative blocks.

points.title: 晚年巅峰
points.description: 1980年代，黑泽明的创作迎来第二春，他执导了《影子武士》(1980)、《乱》(1985)和《梦》(1990)等晚期杰作。《乱》改编自莎士比亚的《李尔王》，获得了戛纳电影节评审团大奖。1985年，他获得了奥斯卡终身成就奖。晚年，黑泽明继续创作，尽管健康问题日益严重，他仍然保持着对电影艺术的热情。他的晚期作品更加关注生命、死亡和自然等永恒主题，展现了他作为电影大师的深厚艺术造诣。1998年，黑泽明在东京逝世，享年88岁，被公认为世界电影史上最具影响力的导演之一。
points.descriptionEn: In the 1980s, Kurosawa's career experienced a renaissance with late masterpieces such as 'Kagemusha' (1980), 'Ran' (1985), and 'Dreams' (1990). 'Ran,' an adaptation of Shakespeare's 'King Lear,' won the Cannes Film Festival Jury Prize. In 1985, he received an Academy Honorary Award. In his later years, Kurosawa continued to create despite worsening health, maintaining his passion for cinematic art. His late works focused more on eternal themes like life, death, and nature, showcasing his profound artistic mastery. Kurosawa died in Tokyo in 1998 at the age of 88, widely regarded as one of the most influential directors in film history.

supporter.zh: 黑泽明被誉为'电影界的莎士比亚'，他的作品融合了东西方文化精髓，创造了独特的视觉语言和叙事风格。他通过电影探索普遍的人性主题，超越了文化和时代的界限。他对电影技术的创新，如移动摄影和快速剪辑，影响了全球电影制作。黑泽明不仅是一位杰出的导演，更是一位人道主义艺术家，他的作品始终关注个体的尊严和正义，为世界电影留下了宝贵的艺术遗产。
supporter.en: Kurosawa is hailed as 'the Shakespeare of cinema,' whose works blend Eastern and Western cultural essences to create a unique visual language and narrative style. Through his films, he explored universal human themes that transcended cultural and temporal boundaries. His innovations in film techniques, such as moving camera work and rapid editing, influenced global filmmaking. Kurosawa was not just a great director but a humanistic artist whose work consistently focused on individual dignity and justice, leaving an invaluable artistic legacy for world cinema.

critic.zh: 批评者指出黑泽明早期作品受到日本军国主义影响，部分电影带有明显的宣传色彩。一些评论家认为他的西方化叙事风格过于脱离日本传统美学，导致在日本国内评价两极。此外，他对演员特别是三船敏郎的严苛要求也备受争议。黑泽明晚期作品被认为过于自我重复，缺乏创新性，且对历史事件的改编有时过于简化复杂的社会背景。这些批评反映了艺术创作中的文化认同困境和商业与艺术的平衡问题。
critic.en: Critics point out that Kurosawa's early works were influenced by Japanese militarism, with some films containing obvious propaganda elements. Some commentators argue that his Westernized narrative style was too detached from traditional Japanese aesthetics, leading to polarized evaluations in Japan. Additionally, his harsh treatment of actors, especially Toshiro Mifune, has been controversial. His late works are considered overly self-repetitive and lacking innovation, and his adaptations of historical events sometimes oversimplify complex social contexts. These criticisms reflect the dilemmas of cultural identity and the balance between commerce and art in creative work.

objective.zh: 从历史与流行文化视角看，黑泽明已成为日本文化的国际象征，他的作品被重新解读为东西方文化交流的桥梁。在电影史上，他被视为日本电影黄金时代的代表人物，影响了斯皮尔伯格、科波拉等西方导演。他的电影被广泛应用于学术研究和文化分析，成为理解战后日本社会变迁的重要窗口。流行文化中，'黑泽明风格'成为一种美学范式，影响了从电影到广告的多个领域。黑泽明的一生反映了20世纪日本从传统到现代、从封闭到开放的转型历程，他的艺术成就超越了国界，成为世界文化遗产的重要组成部分。
objective.en: From a historical and pop culture perspective, Kurosawa has become an international symbol of Japanese culture, with his works reinterpreted as a bridge between Eastern and Western cultural exchange. In film history, he is regarded as a representative figure of Japan's golden age of cinema, influencing Western directors like Spielberg and Coppola. His films are widely used in academic research and cultural analysis, serving as an important window for understanding post-war Japanese societal changes. In popular culture, 'Kurosawa style' has become an aesthetic paradigm influencing various fields from film to advertising. Kurosawa's life reflects Japan's transformation from tradition to modernity and from isolation to openness in the 20th century, with his artistic achievements transcending borders to become an important part of world cultural heritage.

self.zh: 电影是一面镜子，它反映现实，但也是一扇窗，让我们看到不同的世界。
self.en: Film is a mirror that reflects reality, but it is also a window that allows us to see different worlds.

others.zh: 黑泽明是电影界的莎士比亚，他的作品将东方哲学与西方叙事完美融合，创造了永恒的艺术杰作。
others.en: Akira Kurosawa is the Shakespeare of cinema; his works perfectly blend Eastern philosophy with Western narrative to create timeless artistic masterpieces.
